skill.summary: 专门用于在 Windows 环境下将 AutoCAD DWG 图纸转换为 DXF 格式。 当用户提到“DWG转DXF”、“图纸格式转换”、“处理DWG”，或工作流接收到 .dwg 后缀的文件并需要解析前置处理时，必须立即触发本技能。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of dwg-to-dxf-converter:

- Converts AutoCAD DWG drawings to DXF format specifically on Windows.
- Automatically activates when DWG-to-DXF conversion is requested or a .dwg file is detected in workflows.
- Utilizes a local ODA File Converter for efficient, silent batch processing.
- Provides a clear command for invoking conversion through a Python script.
